resources.string: Play your phone\'s music on Sonos speakers over WiFi.
No speakers found. Make sure your phone is on the same WiFi as your Sonos.
Music plays a few seconds behind the phone; that reserve is what keeps it from skipping. Some apps block audio capture and will stay silent. Your phone keeps playing too, so turn its volume down.
The audio permission is needed to capture music from other apps.

Applies straight away, even while casting. For no skips, keep it towards Smooth: the speaker gets this much music as a reserve, and music starts and stays this far behind the phone. If \"Skipped audio\" rises, move it further towards Smooth.
\"Only NetEase\" keeps other apps\' sounds on the phone. If Sonos stays silent while NetEase plays and \"Silence sent\" keeps rising, NetEase is blocking capture.
Stop casting to change format, sample rate, link type or source. Buffer changes apply straight away.
AAC uses far less WiFi, so short WiFi stalls hurt less. Try it if \"Skipped audio\" rises.
48 kHz matches most phones\' internal audio and the Arc. Try it if skips continue.
How the stream is handed to Sonos. Radio types may stop reconnects (\"Connections\" above 1). If one won\'t play, try another or reset to defaults.
